facts.text: The Access NWU Scholarship Program funds 100% of tuition through federal, state, and NWU merit-based and need-based aid (including Subsidized Federal Direct Loan eligibility) for most first-year and transfer students qualifying for the federal Pell Grant.

sources.title: Access NWU Scholarship Program | NWU
sources.quote: The Access NWU Scholarship Program funds 100% of tuition through federal, state and NWU merit-based and need-based aid (including the student's Subsidized Federal Direct Loan eligibility) for most first-year and transfer students who qualify for the federal Pell Grant.
